---
title: "Interactive Stock Charts"
---

```{=html}
<style>
    .header {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0066cc 0%, #004a99 100%);
        color: white;
        padding: 20px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .stock-selector {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    select {
        padding: 8px 12px;
        font-size: 16px;
        border: 1px solid #ddd;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background-color: white;
    }

    #stockTitle {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 2em;
    }

    .header-info {
        display: flex;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-size: 18px;
    }

    .chart-controls {
        display: flex;
        gap: 20px;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-group {
        display: flex;
        gap: 5px;
    }

    button {
        padding: 8px 16px;
        border: 1px solid #ccc;
        background: white;
        cursor: pointer;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-weight: 500;
        transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    button:hover {
        background: #f5f5f5;
        border-color: #0066cc;
    }

    button.active {
        background: #0066cc;
        color: white;
        border-color: #0066cc;
    }

    #chart {
        width: 100%;
        height: 600px;
    }

    .stats-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
        gap: 15px;
        margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .stat-box {
        border-left: 4px solid #0066cc;
        padding: 15px;
        background: #f9f9f9;
        border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .stat-label {
        color: #666;
        font-size: 12px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .stat-value {
        font-size: 20px;
        font-weight: 600;
        margin-top: 5px;
        color: #333;
    }

    .change-up {
        color: #28a745;
    }

    .change-down {
        color: #dc3545;
    }

    .chart-type-label {
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #333;
    }
</style>

<div class="header">
    <div class="stock-selector">
        <label for="stockSelect" style="font-weight: 600; margin-right: 10px;">Select Stock:</label>
        <select id="stockSelect" onchange="changeStock()">
            <option value="AAPL">AAPL - Apple</option>
            <option value="GOOGL">GOOGL - Google</option>
            <option value="MSFT">MSFT - Microsoft</option>
            <option value="AMZN">AMZN - Amazon</option>
            <option value="TSLA">TSLA - Tesla</option>
            <option value="NVDA">NVDA - NVIDIA</option>
            <option value="META">META - Meta</option>
            <option value="NFLX">NFLX - Netflix</option>
            <option value="ADBE">ADBE - Adobe</option>
            <option value="INTC">INTC - Intel</option>
        </select>
    </div>
    <h1 id="stockTitle">AAPL</h1>
    <div class="header-info">
        <div class="price-display" id="currentPrice">--</div>
        <div class="price-change" id="priceChange">--</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="chart-controls">
    <span class="chart-type-label">Chart Type:</span>
    <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="active" onclick="changeChartType('candlestick')">Candlestick</button>
        <button onclick="changeChartType('line')">Line</button>
        <button onclick="changeChartType('ohlc')">OHLC</button>
    </div>

    <span class="chart-type-label" style="margin-left: 30px;">Time Period:</span>
    <div class="btn-group">
        <button onclick="filterData('1m')">1M</button>
        <button onclick="filterData('3m')">3M</button>
        <button onclick="filterData('6m')">6M</button>
        <button onclick="filterData('1y')">1Y</button>
        <button class="active" onclick="filterData('all')">All</button>
    </div>
</div>

<div id="chart"></div>

<div class="stats-grid">
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">Open</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-open">--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">High (Period)</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-high">--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">Low (Period)</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-low">--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">Avg Volume</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-volume">--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">52W High</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-52w-high">--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-label">52W Low</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-52w-low">--</div>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<script>
    let fullData = [];
    let currentChartType = 'candlestick';
    let currentFilter = 'all';
    let currentStock = 'AAPL';

    // Load CSV data
    async function loadData(stock = 'AAPL') {
        currentStock = stock;
        document.getElementById('stockTitle').textContent = stock;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`downloads/${stock}.csv`);
            const csvText = await response.text();
            
            Papa.parse(csvText, {
                header: true,
                skipEmptyLines: true,
                complete: function(results) {
                    fullData = results.data.map(row => ({
                        date: row.date,
                        open: parseFloat(row.open),
                        high: parseFloat(row.high),
                        low: parseFloat(row.low),
                        close: parseFloat(row.close),
                        volume: parseInt(row.volume)
                    })).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));

                    updateChart();
                    updateStats();
                },
                error: function(error) {
                    document.getElementById('chart').innerHTML = 
                        '<div class="error">Error loading data: ' + error.message + '</div>';
                }
            });
        } catch (error) {
            document.getElementById('chart').innerHTML = 
                '<div class="error">Could not load CSV file for ' + stock + '</div>';
        }
    }

    function changeStock() {
        const stock = document.getElementById('stockSelect').value;
        loadData(stock);
    }

    function getFilteredData() {
        if (currentFilter === 'all') return fullData;
        
        const now = new Date();
        let cutoffDate = new Date();
        
        if (currentFilter === '1m') cutoffDate.setMonth(now.getMonth() - 1);
        else if (currentFilter === '3m') cutoffDate.setMonth(now.getMonth() - 3);
        else if (currentFilter === '6m') cutoffDate.setMonth(now.getMonth() - 6);
        else if (currentFilter === '1y') cutoffDate.setFullYear(now.getFullYear() - 1);
        
        return fullData.filter(d => new Date(d.date) >= cutoffDate);
    }

    function updateChart() {
        const data = getFilteredData();
        if (data.length === 0) return;

        let trace;
        
        if (currentChartType === 'candlestick') {
            trace = {
                x: data.map(d => d.date),
                open: data.map(d => d.open),
                high: data.map(d => d.high),
                low: data.map(d => d.low),
                close: data.map(d => d.close),
                type: 'candlestick',
                name: currentStock,
                increasing: { line: { color: '#28a745' } },
                decreasing: { line: { color: '#dc3545' } }
            };
        } else if (currentChartType === 'ohlc') {
            trace = {
                x: data.map(d => d.date),
                open: data.map(d => d.open),
                high: data.map(d => d.high),
                low: data.map(d => d.low),
                close: data.map(d => d.close),
                type: 'ohlc',
                name: currentStock,
                increasing: { line: { color: '#28a745' } },
                decreasing: { line: { color: '#dc3545' } }
            };
        } else {
            trace = {
                x: data.map(d => d.date),
                y: data.map(d => d.close),
                type: 'scatter',
                mode: 'lines',
                name: currentStock,
                line: { color: '#0066cc', width: 2 },
                hovertemplate: '%{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>Close: $%{y:.2f}<extra></extra>'
            };
        }

        const layout = {
            title: '',
            xaxis: {
                rangeslider: { visible: false },
                type: 'date'
            },
            yaxis: {
                title: 'Price ($)',
                gridcolor: '#f0f0f0'
            },
            hovermode: 'x unified',
            margin: { b: 80 },
            plot_bgcolor: '#fafafa',
            paper_bgcolor: 'white'
        };

        Plotly.newPlot('chart', [trace], layout, { responsive: true });
    }

    function updateStats() {
        const data = getFilteredData();
        if (data.length === 0) return;

        const lastRow = data[data.length - 1];
        const firstRow = data[0];
        
        const closes = data.map(d => d.close);
        const opens = data.map(d => d.open);
        const highs = data.map(d => d.high);
        const lows = data.map(d => d.low);
        const volumes = data.map(d => d.volume);

        const minPrice = Math.min(...lows);
        const maxPrice = Math.max(...highs);
        const avgVolume = Math.round(volumes.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / volumes.length);
        const priceChange = lastRow.close - firstRow.open;
        const percentChange = ((priceChange / firstRow.open) * 100).toFixed(2);

        document.getElementById('currentPrice').textContent = `$${lastRow.close.toFixed(2)}`;
        document.getElementById('priceChange').innerHTML = 
            `<span class="${priceChange >= 0 ? 'change-up' : 'change-down'}">
                ${priceChange >= 0 ? '+' : ''}$${priceChange.toFixed(2)} (${percentChange}%)
            </span>`;

        document.getElementById('stat-open').textContent = `$${firstRow.open.toFixed(2)}`;
        document.getElementById('stat-high').textContent = `$${maxPrice.toFixed(2)}`;
        document.getElementById('stat-low').textContent = `$${minPrice.toFixed(2)}`;
        document.getElementById('stat-volume').textContent = 
            `${(avgVolume / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M`;
        document.getElementById('stat-52w-high').textContent = 
            `$${(Math.max(...closes)).toFixed(2)}`;
        document.getElementById('stat-52w-low').textContent = 
            `$${(Math.min(...closes)).toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function changeChartType(type) {
        currentChartType = type;
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group')[0].querySelectorAll('button').forEach((btn, i) => {
            btn.classList.remove('active');
        });
        event.target.classList.add('active');
        updateChart();
    }

    function filterData(period) {
        currentFilter = period;
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group')[1].querySelectorAll('button').forEach((btn, i) => {
            btn.classList.remove('active');
        });
        event.target.classList.add('active');
        updateChart();
        updateStats();
    }

    // Load data on page load
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        loadData('AAPL');
    });
</script>
```
